name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 4.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 35 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2025-12-25, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
